key.name: notifications
key.description: Plays a sound when a notification or new mail arrives. Do Not Disturb, the lock screen, a fullscreen game and sharing the screen keep them quiet.

key.name: devices
key.description: Plays a sound when a USB or Bluetooth device connects or disconnects, when the charger is plugged in, and when the battery runs low.

key.name: volume-feedback
key.description: Plays a short tick on the output whose volume changed, from the volume keys or slider.

key.name: screenshots
key.description: Plays a shutter sound when a screenshot is saved.

key.name: recording
key.description: Plays a sound when screen recording, screen sharing, the camera or dictation starts and stops.

key.name: sign-in
key.description: Plays a sound once when the desktop appears after signing in.

key.name: keyboard
key.description: Plays a soft tap for each key on the on-screen keyboard, with their own sounds for delete and space.
